== Notes ==
* You lose exactly 8 energy from the -4 [[pip]]s over 6 seconds.
* If the signet is renewed before it ends, the caster will gain energy for each time the skill was activated.
* This skill will provide more total energy gain per second than [[Ether Signet]].
* Signet of Recall is particularly useful:
**When encountering heavy [[energy denial]], e.g. from a [[Mursaat Tower (skill)|Mursaat Tower]] (the energy degeneration from Signet of Recall will have no effect since your energy has already been depleted).
**When you already have Ether Signet on your [[skill bar]] and need even more energy without having to use skills that require energy. 
**When you are facing many short battles (since Signet of Recall can be used right before the battle, during which time the energy degeneration is not disadvantageous).
**When [[energy hiding]], you will not lose any energy from this skill while your current energy is 0.
